title: Liability, Medical Payments and Deductible Options by Manufactured Home Insurance Form
content:
Three figures on a Manufactured Home Insurance declarations page are chosen or fixed by form rather than derived from the dwelling limit: the personal liability limit, the medical payments limit and the all-other-perils deductible.

| Policy form | Personal liability limits that may be chosen | Medical payments to others, per person | All-other-perils deductibles that may be chosen |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | $100000 or $300000 | $1000 | $500, $1000 or $2500 |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | $100000 or $300000 | $1000 | $500, $1000 or $2500 |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | $100000 or $300000 | $2000 | $500, $1000 or $2500 |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | $100000 or $300000 | $2000 | $500, $1000 or $2500 |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | $100000, $300000 or $500000 | $5000 | $500, $1000 or $2500 |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | $100000, $300000 or $500000 | $5000 | $500, $1000 or $2500 |

## Reading the options

- The liability limit and the deductible are each one choice from the list shown for the form; the medical payments limit is a single fixed amount per person for the form.
- A $500000 liability limit is offered only on the two Special forms.
- Every form offers the same three deductible choices.

## Options answered

- Can a Broad form carry $500,000 of liability? No; both Broad forms list only $100000 and $300000.
- What medical payments limit comes with the Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost? $5000 per person.
- Can a deductible of $750 be chosen? No form lists $750; the choices are $500, $1000 and $2500.
